reading: The one N03 operator library the runtime loads (#549 S2-2, P-N03 rev 3d, owner decision O-N03-2). shipping/CMakeLists.txt compiles these values into the loader's pin (n03_operator_pin.cpp.in); the runtime reads neither this file nor a caller attestation to decide what it accepts. Configure and install refuse a pin that is not the tracked realization attestation's op_library. A new digest needs a new admission record (saccade_n03_admission), review, this file updated and the runtime rebuilt; deploying it needs a package re-pin. Admission is the ELF search-path rule only: it does not vouch for how the object's DT_NEEDED dependencies resolve.
